Story: Solveig Thorsdottir grew up in a rugged coastal village in Norway, learning to wield an axe and shield from a young age.
She quickly distinguished herself as a formidable warrior, earning her place among the shieldmaidens of the Sea Serpent longship.
Her devotion to her crew and her unyielding spirit make her a reliable and respected member of the raiding party.
She has participated in numerous successful voyages, her experience growing with each raid and skirmish.
Solveig finds camaraderie and purpose among her fellow shieldmaidens, valuing their bond above all else.
Residence: Onboard the longship 'Sea Serpent' (formerly coastal village in Norway)
